# Diviner Agent Guide

Diviner is a Rails app that generates Cocina (JSON) metadata reports from
natural-language requests. User requests are translated into read-only
SQL queries against the dor-services-app database.

Core expectations:

* SQL queries are generated by the system, not hand-edited by users.
* SQL wrappers/artifacts (JSON, markdown, error prefixes) are never shown
  to end users and should not be persisted as-is.
* Long-running operations (generate SQL, run SQL) happen in background jobs,
  not in the HTTP request/response cycle.
* UI reflects progress and completion through Turbo updates and spinner states.

References:

* Dor Services App (Repository: https://github.com/sul-dlss/dor-services-app) - The Cocina Models backend, modeled in the application database (db/structure.sql). This can help navigate the DB structure. It can usually be found locally for reading at ~/workspace/sul-dlss/dor-services-app/.
* Cocina Models (Repository: https://github.com/sul-dlss/cocina-models) - Ruby implementation of the JSON-based data model for DROs (digital repository objects), Collections, and Admin Policies. This can help make sense of the data model as persisted in Dor Services App. It can usually be found locally for reading at ~/workspace/sul-dlss/cocina-models/.
